name: Coated canvas
summary: Cotton or linen canvas covered with lacquer, paint or resin, so that it sheds rain, wipes clean and takes a printed pattern.
how: Stretch the canvas flat and apply the coat in thin layers, 3 or more.
Dry each layer, then stove or press the surface to a smooth finish.
Print or stripe the pattern before the last coat, so that the coat protects it.

origin.note: Louis Vuitton covers the flat-topped trunk in grey lacquered canvas; it is light, weatherproof and does not crack as leather does.

adoptions.via: The Vuitton workshop adds a stripe to the coated canvas, the first pattern on a trunk.
Luxury houses print a mark across the whole coated canvas of bags and belts.
